source_anchors.role: Actual final Lambda1 is retained, a union of original compatible LMR1 cells; shrinking it by the source hull operation preserves the whole-first-block alignment. No new region or enlarged integration domain is chosen.
Condition the remaining free variables outside the original Lambda1, keeping U1 as background, actual cross forcing, all interactions, cutoffs and original outer factors.
The source conditions a free Gaussian by its selected-free coordinate partition. The conditional covariance notation refers to this operation; marginal covariance is not substituted.

fixed_data_and_geometry: Keep the original compatible periodic source lattice, actual mean0.4 OR0.12, Omega1, Lambda=Lambda1 subset Omega1, U1,V,V0, all source norms/metrics, independent positive orientations and original pivots. Inverse orientations are dependent.

Both Omega1 and Lambda are unions of source whole first-level blocks with their original compatible cell/site conventions. Incident fine/coarse bonds mean the declared source incidence, not incidence after taking geometric complement. No isolated-face set or arbitrary sub-block region is used.
Let A be the original independent active fine bonds incident to Omega1, I the original active coarse rows, beta(I) the original pivots, and S=A minus beta(I) the original globally free variables.

Set A_in=A intersect E_fine(Lambda), A_out=A minus A_in; I_in=I intersect E_coarse(Lambda), J=I minus I_in. Define beta_in=beta(I_in), beta_out=beta(J), D=S intersect A_in, E=S minus D. Here A_out is a FINE LINEAR fluctuation index set, E an OUTER FREE index set, neither is the raw fixed F_src of Omega1.

The source whole-cell geometry gives beta_in subset A_in and beta_out subset A_out, with beta_out disjoint A_in. Thus D is exactly the actual Lambda star free set relative to the original global selected list.

For c in J both endpoint blocks lie outside Lambda. Each actual mean row depends only on the two endpoint blocks, its internal root paths, reference coarse path and corridor translations; all its fine inputs are outside E_fine(Lambda). This support statement holds for the actual nonlinear group mean, not just its flat derivative.

Work on one actually admitted source branch of N(B)=B-hD_sel(B), F(N(B))=P B, N_S(B)=B_S, with original P=DF(0) and invertible original selected blocks. The full source K_C, branch coverage and uniform inverse are not assumed proved.

linear_support_identity.support_zero: P_(J,A_in)=0. With rows/pivots ordered as I_in,J and beta_in,beta_out, P_(J,beta_in)=0 and the exterior selected block P_(J,beta_out) is invertible (in the physical row-pivot dictionary it is diagonal by row).
linear_support_identity.lift: C_rec has P C_rec=0 and pi_S C_rec=I. For free input i_D u, the free entries on A_out are0; the J equations force its selected beta_out entries0. Therefore pi_(A_out) C_rec i_D=0.
linear_support_identity.exact_image: image(C_rec i_D)={x in kerP: x_(A_out)=0}. The converse uses x=C_rec pi_S x and support of pi_S x in D.
linear_support_identity.local_lift: Let P_Lambda=P_(I_in,A_in) with the SAME background U1 and original trace pairings; let C_Lambda lift D into A_in by the original beta_in rows. Then C_rec i_D=i_(A_in) C_Lambda. This is the homogeneous VARIATION map at fixed outer free data, not a change of minimum.
linear_support_identity.precision: For the actual bare Delta1 and Q_free=C_recsharp Delta1 C_rec of1813, Q_D=i_Dsharp Q_free i_D=C_Lambdasharp i_(A_in)sharp Delta1 i_(A_in) C_Lambda. This is the original current/soft-gauge quadratic form on kerP with precisely the typed incident fine Dirichlet condition. It is not the old axial-source operator.
linear_support_identity.metric_scope: Injections, projections and sharps use the same original repeated Lie metrics and independent-coordinate pairings, with trace metric counted once as1813 receipt requires. No extra Gram, boundary or normalizer factor follows from a tangent image equality.

nonlinear_outer_reconstruction.subsystem: The actual coarse rows F_J depend only on fine x_(A_out) and fixed raw exterior. Their equation F_J(N(B))=P_J B therefore uses only B_(A_out), the exterior free entries, and exterior selected outputs. Selected outputs beta_in cannot enter F_J.
nonlinear_outer_reconstruction.local_independence: On an admitted local selected branch, implicit uniqueness for this exterior subsystem gives d_(B_in) N(B)_(A_out)=0. Equivalently the outside block of DN has zero inside-to-outside block. This can also be derived by differentiating F_J and using the invertible exterior selected derivative on that branch.
nonlinear_outer_reconstruction.conditional_field: For R_in(a)=a_D and the source shell R_E depending only on a_E and fixed background data, B=g0 C_rec[i_D a_D+i_E R_E(a_E)]. Its outside fine part is independent of a_D; so the complete U_(A_out)=exp(i N(B)_(A_out)) U1_(A_out) is locally independent of a_D.
nonlinear_outer_reconstruction.branch_limit: Zero inner derivative gives a constant outside value on each connected inner chart section. A global function of a_E alone across disconnected sections or multiple outside roots requires a consistent UNIQUE exterior branch. Keep that original branch/component label in the outer data; no unproved full-K_C coverage or global uniqueness is inferred.
nonlinear_outer_reconstruction.nonzero_outer_offset: The full B includes B^E=g0 C_rec i_E R_E(a_E), which can have selected INSIDE entries. Retain N(B^E+g0 C_rec i_D a_D) and the original U1. Do not replace it by a homogeneous C_Lambda a_D map or a new localized minimum. Fine exterior values within Omega1 are reconstructed functions of a_E and branch, not generally the original V0.
nonlinear_outer_reconstruction.constraints: On B with P B=0 the outside rows J already satisfy the original V_J constraint through that exterior reconstruction. No new delta, sector division or field replacement is introduced.

conditional_gaussian_reference.kernel: For the original free reference Q_free, at fixed a_E the first inner Lebesgue kernel is exp[-1/2<a_D,Q_D a_D>-<a_D,Q_DE a_E>], with Q_DE=i_Dsharp Q_free i_E. All original v/V, indicators, boundary factors and words remain multiplied into it.
conditional_gaussian_reference.reference_covariance_only: If the actual real Q_D is positive definite, its UNTRUNCATED Gaussian reference covariance is Q_D^-1, mean m_D=-Q_D^-1 Q_DE a_E. It is not the marginal block (Q_free^-1)_DD and not the covariance of the complete truncated/interacting physical conditional law.
conditional_gaussian_reference.normalization: Converting that kernel to normalized mean-m_D Gaussian adds exactly its original Gaussian determinant factor Z_D and exp[+1/2<Q_DE a_E,Q_D^-1 Q_DE a_E>]. All outer Gaussian action and source baseline remain. If shifting to centered coordinates, the fixed original cutoff becomes its translated set; do not keep the old box unchanged.
conditional_gaussian_reference.no_positivity_claim: The support/precision identity does not prove positivity, inverse bounds, contours or a hard-to-soft comparison. Those actual same-family witnesses remain required.
conditional_gaussian_reference.empty_case: If D is empty, use the zero-dimensional integral/determinant1 and keep every original outer factor; no artificial inner root or covariance is introduced.

marked_operator_consequence.pure_exterior: On each consistent admitted exterior branch, a COMPLETE ordered original word whose every fine factor and any variable root/endpoint frame input lies outside E_fine(Lambda), or is already fixed outer data, is independent of a_D. Its value is c_r(a_E,V,V0,branch). All factors/inverses/frames remain.
marked_operator_consequence.two_exterior_notions: If support is entirely in the original raw F_src of Omega1 it is the original prescribed V0 word. If support lies outside Lambda but within the active Omega1 exterior, it is instead the reconstructed outer word just described. Do not call both V0.
marked_operator_consequence.coefficient_identity: For one such deterministic p mark, the four coefficients of the original inner polynomial integral are (I0,c_p I0,I_q,c_p I_q) on that branch; analogous q/both cases retain their exact original factors. This identity needs no division and remains true when I0=0.
marked_operator_consequence.crossing: An outside root alone is insufficient. A word with any active fine factor or variable frame path entering E_fine(Lambda) retains its full actual reconstruction and inner carrier, including selected inside outputs. No product of independent roots or vacuum smallness is inferred.
marked_operator_consequence.outer_history: The c_r remain inside the original a_E,V0,V,branch and sector integrations BEFORE any physical logarithm. A zero mixed conditional log coefficient, when defined, does not make the final physical covariance zero. Their background/exterior/interpolation derivatives can be nonzero and must not be dropped.

payoff: This aims to close only the exact current-mean incident-domain free-clamping/fine-support dictionary and the corresponding pure-outer word classification on admitted branches, using the actual source Lambda. It does not close the old-hard mean/gauge/current gap, full nonlinear domain or uniform marked/profile/history problem.
falsifiers: A source-admitted actual Lambda not aligned as required, a J row whose mean uses a fine input in A_in, or an outside pivot in A_in would invalidate the geometric support inference.
A nonzero pi_(A_out) C_rec i_D under the actual definitions would refute the linear dictionary; no generic arbitrary-region or L3 test is substituted for the source geometry.
N outside dependence on a_D within the SAME admitted exterior branch would refute the nonlinear assertion. Different disconnected/multiroot branches are an explicitly retained limitation.
A supposedly pure-exterior word whose hidden variable frame/path enters the inside, or cancellation of its outer/history dependence, would violate the marked classification.
No old hard gamma0, uniform inverse, source189/190 or physical normalized theorem follows merely from this identity.
